prompt:
The section file sections/logo-list-strip.liquid renders a strip of partner/brand logos. The markup above the schema is correct and must not change. The {% schema %} JSON is incomplete: the markup reads section.settings.logos_per_row and block.settings.link, which are not declared. The section also has no block limit and cannot be added from the theme editor.

Replace the schema JSON so that it is exactly the following. Schemas are compared as parsed JSON: key order inside objects does not matter, but array order does. Do not add any other keys.

Top level:
- "name": "Logo list"
- "tag": "section"
- "class": "section-logo-list"
- "max_blocks": 12 (number)

"settings", in this order:
1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Trusted by".
2. type "select", id "layout", label "Layout", default "grid". Its options, in order:
   - value "grid", label "Grid"
   - value "carousel", label "Carousel"
3. type "range", id "logos_per_row", label "Logos per row", min 2, max 6, step 1, default 4. All four are numbers. There is no unit key.

"blocks": exactly one block definition with type "logo" and name "Logo". Its "settings", in order:
1. type "image_picker", id "image", label "Image"
2. type "text", id "alt_text", label "Alt text"
3. type "url", id "link", label "Link"
None of these block settings has a default.

"presets": exactly one preset with name "Logo list". Its "blocks" array contains exactly four entries, each {"type": "logo"}.

Keep the markup byte-for-byte. Keep exactly one {% schema %} block at the end of the file. Change only sections/logo-list-strip.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
